free_tier.correction: Conditional/provider-specific: Bridge charges no additional service fees, but MLS or data-provider licensing fees may apply.

free_tier_limits.correction: No universal paid-only rule or free-tier allowance; Bridge service fees are zero, while provider licensing fees and conditions vary.

rate_limits.correction: Default platform limits are 5,000 requests/hour and 334 requests/minute; Zillow Public Records is additionally limited to 1,000 requests/day by default.

cors.correction: Supported for direct browser requests using a Browser Token and configured Referrer Domain.
